candidate_selection: latest 400 unheld completed model heads by original first observation and match ID
split: chronological 80% development / 20% evaluation, assigned before validation; rejected candidates are not replaced
sampling: first original per tick; at most 40 original frames at uniformly spaced retained indexes
terminal: original completed feature snapshot; exact winner/mode/rules agreement with retained source match; no inferred terminal
original_payloads: stored envelope, canonical feature hash and frozen model recomputation must agree
draws: retained and explicitly excluded from metrics by the original evaluator
